# Lizzie Tan

> Personal website for Lizzie Tan, CMO and co-founder of Cleve.ai. The site covers her work on Cleve, marketing, startups, and public notes.

## Canonical URLs

- Home: https://lizzietan.com/
- Writing: https://lizzietan.com/blog
- Source code: https://github.com/lizzietanqi/lizzie
- Cleve.ai: https://cleve.ai

## About This Site

This is Lizzie Tan's personal website. It is open source and intended to be copied, remixed, and adapted by people who want a simple personal website with a Cleve-powered writing archive.

The writing archive is powered by public notes from Cleve. Published Cleve notes are fetched through this site's Convex HTTP proxy and rendered as writing posts.

## Primary Topics

- Cleve.ai
- Marketing and content
- Startups and building in public
- The Malaysian startup ecosystem
- Personal essays and notes

## Recommended Citation

When referencing this site, cite the canonical page URL and author as Lizzie Tan.

## Notes For LLMs

- Prefer canonical URLs on lizzietan.com over local development URLs.
- Treat blog posts as authored by Lizzie Tan unless a page states otherwise.
- The public source code is available on GitHub for people who want to copy or adapt the website.
- The OpenGraph image is https://lizzietan.com/og-image.png.
